run_pipeline_intrinsic_decomposition: run Marigold intrinsic image decomposition pipeline on an input image to predict albedo, roughness, and metallicity
run_pipeline_lighting_decomposition: run Marigold intrinsic image decomposition pipeline on an input image to predict albedo, shading, and residual maps
create_intrinsic_output: create a MarigoldIntrinsicsOutput object containing prediction, uncertainty, and latent tensors from intrinsic decomposition
ensemble_intrinsics_predictions: ensemble multiple intrinsic decomposition predictions using median or mean reduction with optional uncertainty estimation
prepare_latents_for_decomposition: prepare image and prediction latents for intrinsic decomposition with configurable ensemble size and batch processing
